One week is under the 14-day minimum, and no MDE, power, sample size or stopping rule is recorded.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by customer. Run for 1 week. Compare on-time rate between arms.","citations":["experimentation-standards#marketplace-interference","experimentation-standards#duration-and-seasonality","experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Use a geo, market or switchback design and run at least 14 days, or get Data Science sign-off for a shorter test. Pre-register the primary metric, MDE, power and stopping rule."},{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"EXP-014 learning not applied","detail":"The proposal cites EXP-014 but ignores its result: the OTD gain came from relaxed promises, conversion fell 1.2%, and the test was not shipped.
